The talk proceeds in rounds. Each round has 4 turns; in each turn, every participant speaks once, in this fixed order: Asuka, Benjamin, Jonathan, Shunichi and Takumi. On a turn, a participant either speaks, says "Skip" (passes this turn only), or says "Over" (takes no further turns this round). An utterance is anywhere from 1 to 40 words; give it the length and content that suit the moment. An utterance consists only of the participant's own words: no name labels, headings, stage directions or commentary, and no speaking for others. The talk is a conversation among the participants: they respond to one another, asking, answering, agreeing and objecting, and the decision grows out of that exchange.

| 1 | nothing new (the things that can be looked into are listed above, titles only) | 4 turns | each participant chooses 2 of the listed things to look into |
